dialog.title: Play replay

dialog.useRecorded: Use the level recorded for this run
dialog.choosingAndVerifying: Choose a file, then verifying gameplay…
dialog.useAnother: Use another file with identical gameplay

status.waitingForFocus: Waiting for ADOFAI to regain focus…
status.replaceActive: Starting this run will replace the active replay.

run.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes run #{{runIndex}}, its replay data, and its microphone recording. This cannot be undone.

errors.start_failed: Could not start the replay. Make sure the original level opens correctly, then try again.
errors.file_picker_failed: Could not open the file picker. Return to ADOFAI, then try again.
errors.run_not_found: The selected run could not be found. Refresh the activity list.
errors.level_not_found: The level record for this run could not be found. Refresh the activity list.
errors.level_file_missing: The level file could not be found. Restore it to its original location or choose a matching level.
errors.level_gameplay_modified: The selected level no longer matches the recorded gameplay. Choose the original file or another matching level.
errors.level_file_invalid: This level file could not be read. Check that it opens correctly in the ADOFAI editor.
errors.level_hash_unavailable: The original level is needed once to identify this older run. Choose the original file.
errors.level_hash_unsupported: This run was recorded by an older version and cannot be played now. New runs can still be replayed.
errors.metadata_invalid: This run's replay data is damaged and cannot be played. Its play history is still available.
errors.metadata_parse_failed: This run's replay data is damaged and cannot be played. Its play history is still available.
errors.timing_metadata_missing: This run has no replay timing data and cannot be played. Its play history is still available.
errors.native_input_metadata_missing: This run has no input metadata and cannot be played. Its play history is still available.
errors.payload_invalid: This run's replay data is damaged and cannot be played. Its play history is still available.
errors.input_payload_invalid: This run's input data is damaged and cannot be played. Its play history is still available.
errors.hit_context_payload_invalid: This run's judgment data is damaged and cannot be played. Its play history is still available.
errors.payload_empty: This run has no input data to replay. Its play history is still available.
errors.start_tile_invalid: The recorded start position is invalid, so this run cannot be played.
errors.start_tile_negative: The recorded start position is invalid, so this run cannot be played.
errors.start_tile_out_of_range: The level is shorter than when this run was recorded. Choose the original level.
errors.result_unsupported: This run's ending state cannot be replayed by the current version.
errors.native_input_unsupported: This operating system cannot replay the keyboard input in this run.
errors.file_picker_busy: Another file picker is already open. Close it before choosing a level.
errors.file_picker_not_found: That file selection has ended. Choose the file again.
errors.level_not_ready: The level could not be prepared. Check that the original level opens correctly.
errors.level_open_timeout: The level did not open within 30 seconds. Check ADOFAI's loading state, then try again.
errors.editor_transition_failed: An error in another mod prevented ADOFAI from returning to the editor. Check the mod log, then restart the game.
errors.editor_transition_timeout: Returning to the editor took too long. Restart the game and try again.
errors.different_level_current: The open level changed during replay, so playback stopped. Try again with the original level.
errors.editor_quit_to_menu: The editor closed during replay, so playback stopped.
errors.controller_missing: TUFReplay lost ADOFAI's play state and stopped the replay. Restart the game and try again.
